method: Read-only review of twelve current Shopify App Store listings/reviews and official economics/access documentation; stopped early after decisive competition evidence.
hypothesis: A permission-minimal catalog-quality anomaly monitor has a repeated unmet workflow absent from adopted substitutes.

covered_capabilities: Scheduled product and inventory rules, alerts and integrations
Catalog checks, health scores, history and scheduled reports
Bulk editing with preview, scheduling, undo and rollback
Real-time catalog-change alerts, attribution and revert
Missing field, SKU, SEO and quality scoring

economics_model.warning: Six willing paid merchants are not evidenced; this is a mechanical threshold, not expected or realized revenue.

permission_boundary: A basic checker can use read_products, but revenue-impact scoring can trigger protected-customer-data review and automated remediation requires write_products. Incumbents already occupy both read-only and remediation positions.
reason: More than five credible adopted substitutes and seven new exact-purpose apps cover the wedge; no repeated unmet complaint survived comparison.
reopening_conditions: At least ten independent long-tenure merchant reviews repeat the same unsolved catalog workflow.
A new Shopify product/catalog surface is not covered by incumbents.
Verifiable buyer demand identifies a permission-minimal paid wedge.
Incumbent discontinuation or material pricing changes leave a demonstrable gap.
